policies.sentence: AI output, code and explanations can be wrong, inaccurate, hallucinated, incomplete or misleading.
AI-generated code can have security flaws and put the institution at risk.
AI-generated code often fails course requirements, grading tests and good style.
AI tools are trained on old information and may be outdated.
Using AI without knowing what you are doing leads to poor homework submissions.
Students should be cautious with AI and understand its limitations.
Students should use only course-listed packages and classes, not those AI suggests.
Course materials and instructor guidance take precedence over AI output.
Students using AI often get stuck when debugging.
